points.name: health.sleep.survey_done.button_register
points.interpretation: The completion view registers a callback that requests navigation finish.

evidence: The sleep manifest registers all four page descriptors. The setting page registers a switch callback which uses a stored type to change the corresponding state. The setting list registers one navigation callback with values 0, 1, 3 and 4. The survey registers a common callback on five options and a confirmation callback; it advances and can persist responses. The completion view contains an icon, two strings and a finish callback. Each page state slot is cleared in its destroy callback.
scope: Only recorded calls while the relevant page is active. Sleep sensing, backend settings and other data-entry paths are not intercepted.
limitations: Sleep responses and settings can be sensitive. Changing event data or callbacks can desynchronize or alter saved data. Image resources must remain valid while used. State slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
